name: Eloggi
description: Eloggi was the second planet in the Endor system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a frozen, barren rock that possessed no moons. The Galactic Empire established a mining colony on the planet. In the wake of the Battle of Endor, the New Republic allowed a number of Sullustans to take over the operations there.
